title: MSCI Removes Strategy (MSTR) From Its USA Index, Forcing Index Funds to Sell by Nov. 30
summary: Bitcoin Magazine MSCI Removes Strategy (MSTR) From Its USA Index, Forcing Index Funds to Sell by Nov. 30 MSCI will take Strategy, Metaplanet, Yellow Cake, Skel and Upexi out of its global indexes as of the Nov. 30 close, after a new screen classified them as non-operating companies. This post MSCI Removes Strategy (MSTR) From Its USA Index, Forcing Index Funds to Sell by Nov. 30 first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

title: Russia’s Central Bank Clears Exchange to Open Bitcoin and Crypto Trading on Nov. 22
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Russia’s Central Bank Clears Exchange to Open Bitcoin and Crypto Trading on Nov. 22 A Bank of Russia ordinance published Wednesday lets exchanges start organized crypto trading on Nov. 22, but only after the central bank approves their rules. Moscow Exchange still aims for Dec. 1.
